author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** Pre-existing failing unit test in polaris-backend/src/api/error.rs: bad_request_carries_static_message asserts body["error"] == "invalid request: reasoning too short" but the IntoResponse impl emits the bare static message ("reasoning too short"). Either the test or the impl needs to align — the IntoResponse rendering shape is the public contract.

Surfaced during #36's reversal-workflow dispatch; not caused by it.

**Done when.** cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib api::error passes.
